name: telemetry-ledger
description: Record chat-scoped operational metrics, query latency and counters, compare time windows, and surface evidence-backed regression hypotheses without claiming causality.

RETENTION_DAYS.prompt: Days of telemetry events to retain.

MAX_QUERY_EVENTS.prompt: Maximum events loaded for one query.

MAX_RECORDS_PER_CALL.prompt: Maximum measurements accepted in one batch.

MIN_COMPARE_SAMPLES.prompt: Minimum samples in each window before classifying a change.

REGRESSION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT.prompt: Minimum percentage change classified as a regression or improvement.
